items.title: assistant_response
items.content:
I've written the full plan as an OpenSpec change at `openspec/changes/retina-cvd-crao-platform/`. All four artifacts are complete and `openspec validate --strict` passes. No project code was touched.

**What's in it**
- **`proposal.md`**: one web app with two modes that share a single photo-capture step. Screening mode gives a 10-year CVD risk; Emergency mode checks for CRAO. Your existing CRAO prototype gets moved into the new app, and the old copy is deleted once its tests pass.
- **`specs/`**: 8 capabilities, each with testable scenarios:
  - image intake (consent first, metadata stripping, quality gate)
  - image analysis (segmentation, heatmap, calibrated confidence, plain-language explanation)
  - CVD risk (Thai CV Risk + PCE)
  - CRAO triage
  - clinician review
  - FHIR records
  -
